## What this improves

Describe the rider or contributor outcome in plain English.

## What changed

Summarise the implementation and any deliberate limits.

## Validation

List the commands run and any Karoo or VitalPro checks completed. If hardware testing was not needed or was not possible, say why.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `./gradlew test lintDebug assembleDebug --dependency-verification=strict --no-daemon` or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behaviour.
- [ ] I updated user and developer documentation where needed.
- [ ] I marked hardware-dependent behaviour as verified or still unverified.
- [ ] I included no raw FIT files, routes, Bluetooth addresses, sensor IDs, signing material, or private health data.
- [ ] I did not change the application ID, signing identity, FIT developer identity, or update path unintentionally.
- [ ] I understand that my contribution will be distributed under this repository's MIT licence.
